doc: Map s05, the swamp on floor 6 of dungeon 1. The party meets the fisherman Noam, who gives them a Fishing Rod for Grape Juice, finds the villagers acting strangely and meets the swamp master Mardan, who sends them to catch a Priscleen Fish before he turns the three back. Story events 215 to 253 drive this, with the later ones in the s05b script.
